title: Improved 3D Hydrogel Cultures of Primary Glial Cells for In Vitro Modelling of Neuroinflammation
protocol: Pre-heat 15 mL of HBSS and 12.5 mL DMEM/F12 to 37 °C in 50 mL conical centrifuge tubes for each brain.
Heat an additional 25 mL of DMEM/F12 to 37 °C.
Prepare approximately 2 mL of 0.25% trypsin with 1 mM EDTA and pre-heat it about 10 min before use.
Pour enough warm HBSS into sterile, 6 and 10 cm culture dishes to cover the surface.
Prepare one 10 cm dish for every two brains plus an additional 6 cm dish.
Separate the cortices along the midline and cerebellum with brain stem under a dissection microscope.
Peel the thin, semi-transparent layer (meninges) containing blood vessels from each section of tissue and discard.
Grasp the thin layers exposed by the tissue cuts with forceps and carefully pull until major portions are hanging off the brain tissue.
Remove this portion gently by tugging.
Retain the tissue in a culture dish after removing HBSS.
Macerate the tissue with a scalpel and transfer it to the pre-warmed 15 mL tube containing trypsin.
Incubate the tube for 25 min in a 37 °C bath.
Centrifuge the tube at 500 x g for 2 min at room temperature, then pour out the supernatant.
Add 10 mL of warm DMEM/F12 to the pellet using a 10 mL serological pipette and tritrate the solution 5 times.
Centrifuge the tube again at 500 x g for 2 min at room temperature, then pour out the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of warm DMEM/F12 using a 10 mL serological pipette.
Transfer the resuspended solution to a 50 mL Conical centrifuge tube.
Triturate the solution 3 times using a 10 mL syringe with an 18 gauge needle.
Pipette 1 mL increments of the triturated solution into a 12 well plate (1 per brain).
Incubate at 37 °C and 5% CO₂ in a humidified cell culture incubator.
Replace media after three days.
Refresh media every subsequent three days.
Weigh 375 mg of hyaluronic acid (HA) salt in a 50 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Add 37.5 mL of distilled water to the HA salt.
Flush the solution with a vortexer for 1 min.
Sonicate the mixture until it appears homogenous and loses its gel-like viscosity.
Transfer solution to a 100 mL beaker with a magnetic stir bar (38 mm).
Stir vigorously at room temperature.
Titrate 5.0 M NaOH into the mixing HA solution gradually, measuring pH with pH paper until stabilizing between 8 and 12.
Collect 3 mL of fresh methacrylic anhydride (MA), blanketed by nitrogen during storage.
Add 200 µL of MA to the mixing HA solution slowly in a fume hood.
Repeat steps for adding MA until all 3 mL have been added.
Allow the reaction to continue overnight at 4 °C without mixing.
Transfer the solution to 400 mL of cold ethanol in a 500 mL beaker and allow precipitation for 24 - 72 h at 4 °C.
Carefully decant the major portion of the solution into a separate beaker for disposal, and collect the precipitate in a 50 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the tubes at 200 x g in a centrifuge for 2 min at room temperature and dispose of the supernatant.
Top up the tube with cold ethanol, mix the solution with a vortexer for 1 min.
Repeat the previous two steps.
Add 25 mL of sterile deionized water to the precipitate, mix the solution with a vortexer for 1 min.
Sonicate the mixture (>20 kHz) for 1 h and incubate at 4 °C overnight.
Place the solution in a -80 °C freezer for 15 min or until frozen or flash freeze in liquid nitrogen.
Freeze dry the tube (below 0.1 mBar and -30 °C) for 24 - 48 h until a snow-like powder is produced.
Place 18 mm glass coverslips in solution and rock for 1 h at room temperature.
Rinse each coverslip by serially dipping into three beakers of 100 mL deionized water.
Dry the coverslips under vacuum at 40 °C overnight with a desiccator and oven.
Immerse individual coverslips in 70% EtOH without drying.
Drop each wet coverslip into a well of a 12 well plate.
Wash and aspirate each well with sterile deionized water (1 mL per well).
Add 1 mL of sterile 2 µg/mL poly-L-lysine to each well and incubate for >2 h.
Aspirate the PLL solution from each well.
Allow coverslips to air dry.
Immerse PDMS molds in 70% EtOH.
Place one PDMS mold onto the center of each dried coverslip.
Allow PDMS molds to air dry, creating a seal between the mold and glass.
For each 12-well plate of cells, prepare 12.5 mL of dilute trypsin (0.25% trypsin-EDTA diluted 30% with DMEM/F12 media).
Warm the prepared trypsin and 25 mL DMEM/F12 (10% FBS and 1% PS) in a water bath at 37 °C.
Collect conditioned medium from plates using a 10 mL serological pipette (> 0.5 mL per well).

Thoroughly aspirate remaining liquid, then replace with 1 mL per well of dilute trypsin (0.075% trypsin-EDTA) for 20-30 min in an incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2 until the confluent cell layer detaches from the plate.
Recover suspended cell material with a 1 mL pipette and collect it in a 15 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Dilute the collected cells with an equivalent volume of DMEM/F12 (10% FBS and 1% PS), then centrifuge at 200 x g for 2 min at room temperature, discarding the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL warm DMEM/F12 (10% FBS and 1% PS).
Triturate the cells 5 times with a 10 mL pipette and centrifuge at 200 x g for 2 min.
Decant the supernatant, then resuspend the cells in 5 mL warm DMEM/F12 and transfer them to a 50 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Using a 10 mL syringe with a 18 gauge needle, triturate the cell solution 3 times.
Filter the suspension through a 40 µm cell sieve into a new conical centrifuge tube.
Collect 10 µL of cell suspension and dilute it 1:100 in warm DMEM/F12 for counting cells with an automated cell counter.
Incubate the counted cells in a 37 °C water bath until encapsulation step.
Warm 12.5 mL of DMEM/F12 and 12.5 mL of conditioned DMEM/F12 media for each 12-well plate of 3D hydrogels.
Weigh the quantity of methacrylated hyaluronic acid (HAMA) required for a final concentration of 0.5% wt/vol.
Dissolve HAMA in sterile filtered PBS at a concentration of 2% wt/vol.
Sonicate the solution until HAMA is fully dissolved for 60 min.
Prepare individual 10% solutions of triethanolamine (TEA) and 1-vinyl-2-pyrrolidinone (NVP).
Prepare a 1 mM solution of Eosin Y (EY) in sterile PBS pH 7.4.
Mix 1 x 10^7 cells, 350 μL of 2% wt/vol HAMA, 14 μL of 10% TEA, 14 μL of 10% NVP, 14 μL of 1 mM EY, and 280 μL of basal lamina mixture.
Pipette 100 μL of the final solution into each PDMS mold with a 1 mL tip.
Expose samples to high intensity green LED light (~520 nm, 60 mW) for 5 min at room temperature.
Add 1 mL per well of warm conditioned DMEM/F12 to a 12-well plate.
Grasp each coverslip between thumb and forefinger.
Peel the PDMS mold off slowly with curved tweezers without displacing the gel.
Place the coverslip into a well containing conditioned medium.
Add an additional 1 mL warm DMEM/F12 to each well.
Incubate plates at 37 °C with 5% CO2 for 2 weeks.
Refresh cell media every week by pipetting 1 mL of media from each wells and replacing with 1 mL DMEM/F12.
Preheat 10% PBS-buffered formalin (pH 7.0) in a 37 °C bath.
Aspirate media from the plates.
Pipette 1 mL of 10% formalin to each well.
Incubate the plates at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 for 20 min.
Aspirate liquid from each plate.
Pipette 2 mL of PBS (pH 7.4) into each well.
Incubate for 15 min.
Repeat step 4.1.4 twice.
Aspirate liquid from the plates.
Add 1 mL per well of PBS with 10% normal horse serum (NHS) and 0.5% triton X-100.
Gently rock at minimum speed for 1 h.
Repeat step 4.1.4 three times.

Aspirate liquid and add 1 mL per well of the following mixture in PBS: rabbit Iba1 antibody 1:1,000, chicken GFAP antibody 1:5,000, mouse CNPase antibody 1:1,000, 1% NHS, and 0.1% cell perforating surfactant.
Incubate at 4 °C overnight, rocking the plate gently.

Repeat step with 1 mL per well of the following mixture in PBS for three times with 1 h incubations between each repetition: rabbit Iba1 antibody 1:1,000, chicken GFAP antibody 1:5,000, mouse CNPase antibody 1:1,000, 1% NHS, and 0.1% cell perforating surfactant.

Aspirate liquid and add 1 mL per well of the following mixture in PBS: 647 nm excited donkey anti-rabbit antibody 1:200, 546 nm excited goat anti-chicken antibody 1:200, 488 nm excited donkey anti-mouse antibody 1:200, 1% NHS, and 1:1,000 blue nuclear stain.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 h, gently rocking the plate.

Repeat step with 1 mL per well of the following mixture in PBS for three times with 1 h incubations between each repetition: 647 nm excited donkey anti-rabbit antibody 1:200, 546 nm excited goat anti-chicken antibody 1:200, 488 nm excited donkey anti-mouse antibody 1:200, 1% NHS, and 1:1,000 blue nuclear stain.
Aspirate buffer and immerse hydrogels in 0.5 mL of cell mounting medium for 1 min.
Pipette out the mounting medium.
Gently place a coverslip on top of the gel to create a layer between the glass.
Add a small amount of mounting medium to the uncovered side of the coverslips to prevent drying of the hydrogel.
Pre-heat a fixative mixture of 2.5% glutaraldehyde and 2% paraformaldehyde in PBS to 37 °C.
Aspirate the medium from the cell culture plates.
Add 1 mL of the pre-heated fixative mixture to each plate.
Incubate the plates at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 incubator for 20 min.
Place the plates in 4 °C overnight.
Aspirate the fixative solution from the wells.
Add 1 mL of PBS to each well.
Incubate the plates with PBS for 15 min.
Repeat step of aspirating and adding PBS two more times.
Aspirate the PBS.
Add 1 mL of 1% osmium tetraoxide buffered in PBS to each well.
Allow fixation to occur for 30 min.
Aspirate the liquid.
Gradually add ethanol (EtOH).
Incubate at room temperature for the indicated time.
Add hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS).
Place a small plastic platform under the glass slip after the first application of HMDS to prevent adhesion.
Remove the sample after the second EtOH incubation and quench in liquid nitrogen for a few seconds to freeze fracture the sample.
Carefully remove the dried samples.
Mount the samples on scanning electron microscope stubs with double-sided conductive tape.
Sputter coat the samples with a minimum amount of gold.
Place the samples in a holder.
Operate the machine for 2 min at 15 mA.
